description.zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to query or perform the operation.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于重启指定 Supabase 项目。调用成功后返回请求 ID，重启过程会在后端异步执行。
descriptions.en: Restarts a specified Supabase project. After a successful call, a request ID is returned, and the restart process is executed asynchronously in the backend.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb restart-supabase-project --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
